name: PlayM2M
detailed_description:
Embark on an adventure:

  • Explore a vast and open world.

  • Battle powerful enemies.

  • Meet unique characters and stories.

  • Complete mysterious quests.

Improve yourself:

  • Learn powerful spells.

  • Develop unique abilities.

  • Earn epic weapons and armor.

  • Level up and become a master.

  • Play alone or with friends.

Compete in PvP and PvE modes.

  • Create guilds and fight together.

  • Meet players from all over the world.

  • Conquer mysterious worlds with unique mounts and uncover secrets!

  • Have an unforgettable MMORPG experience.Download PlayM2M now and start a fantastic adventure!

What Is PlayM2M ?

PlayM2M is a brand new MMORPG that takes you on an adventure in a fantasy world. In this enchanting game you will discover the secrets of magic and progress on your journey to become a true master.

In this game, you will create your character that you will take on the role and defeat the powerful world bosses and servants in the Arasina continents of the far east. By gaining bonuses of ancient magic to the loot you obtain, you will be able to strengthen your characters or sell them in the empire's market area. The hack and slash style battle system you are familiar with makes the game very action-packed and fun. It will entertain you on every level and make you feel like you are playing the most fun MMO game of your life. You will reach the perfect experience of specializing in every field with a fair and competitive game order.

There are more than 4 different character classes, 4 different dynasties and 2 powerful denominations in the game, and each has its own unique combat abilities. In addition, there are many mounts to accompany you in the game, millions of equipment and accessories to strengthen your pet character, and many different missions, guild wars and PvP arenas. You can also fight as a team with other players or against everyone.

Decide Your Destiny!

• Experience epic 𝑷𝒗𝑬 adventures and 𝑷𝒗𝑷 duels in brutal fierce battles!

• Explore dungeons and labyrinths in massive overworlds!

• Battle countless enemies against world bosses and sinister demon lords.

• Engage in fast-paced battles, even against hordes of enemies.

• Choose a powerful class, become a lord of the empire or a servant of darkness and up to 𝟯𝟬𝟬 level up your character.

𝑪𝑯𝑶𝑶𝑺𝑬 𝒀𝑶𝑼𝑹 𝑷𝑨𝑻𝑯 𝑨𝑵𝑫 𝑭𝑶𝑹𝑮𝑬 𝑨𝑳𝑳𝑰𝑨𝑵𝑪𝑬𝑺

• Choose from four character classes, dynasties and denominations

• Found a guild with friends and build on your lands

• Discover thousands of countless mounts and pets! Soar freely in the sky on the wings of a griffon or fight like a knight on land!

• Continually improve your weapons and equipment through a selection of crafting systems

Play As You Like

Fight, craft, steal, siege or explore and combine different types of armour, weapons and abilities and unique spells to create your own playstyle. In an ever-growing, persistent world of PlayM2M the choice is yours and yours alone.

Tell Your story

Discover the secrets of Tharganir as you journey through the lost and mysterious lands of Aravonuria to reclaim your soul and save the world from Nasfary, god of Hell. Experience one of the epic stories of the four great dynasties with others or alone, in whatever order you choose, anywhere in the vast world.

A Massively Multiplayer RPG

Complete quests with friends, join fellow adventurers to explore dangerous, monster-filled dungeons, or take part in epic PvP battles with hundreds of other players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or better
  • Processor: Intel Core® i3 2.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 7800 GT or ATI Radeon™ X1950 Pro or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or better
  • Processor: Intel Core® i5 2.4 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 3500U or better
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 1080 or AMD RX 5700-XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

  • Storage: 6 GB available space
